how: Explains pixel appeals and reinforcement calls without assuming that the recruited audience and the reported builders constituted one continuous host project.
Explains a warning about the host audience's activity without treating that assessment as a measured shortage of canvas workers.
Explains the visitor's own account that scarce canvas space prompted seeking another group's permission.
Explains disagreement over national representation when a wartime plane is proposed for a postwar flag.
Explains the expansion report as visible evidence of collective construction immediately qualified by renewed pressure.
Explains anchor coordinates in a flag appeal without presuming an agreed pixel template.
Applies the revised starter role to proposing the plane without requiring others to join or identifying who began the older flag.
Explains defence and reinforcement appeals while leaving the revised claim about keepers reversing uninformed planned changes untested.
Explains the correction and denial of a named attacker without claiming either identifies the actual source of blue pixels.
Explains a proposed spatial agreement through alternative positions and an explicit request for host permission.
Uses the revised request-stage range to explain seeking guest space without assuming a permission grant, effective host authority, or a realised guest build.
Makes realised guest building depend on placement remaining possible when recognition of closure terminates the outstanding request.
Connects scarce space to seeking host agreement through the visitor's explicit explanation rather than through an inferred move after losing a work.
Explains recognition of closure ending an outstanding guest request before permission can enable building.
Explains a visitor claiming to speak for two communities while leaving their authorisation of that representation unverified.
Explains prospective site alternatives for a guest sprite before any reported loss without assuming either position was implemented.
Explains national history and nationalist concerns entering design evaluation without making that objection an attack motive.
Explains joking about an alleged attacker's institutional training without presuming reciprocal rivalry, collective uptake, or a running gag.
Requires evidence directed at canvas talk before treating routine approval and question redirection as canvas removal or a newly drawn posting boundary.

statement: Applying ordinary posting approval to canvas proposals
how: Explains the routine automatic posting filter without attributing a canvas-specific removal rule or opposition to the proposed work.
Explains minimal marking of the canvas ending without presuming preservation of a finished mark.
Explains recognition of closure as ending an unfulfilled permission request and prompting an apology for bothering the host.
Explains a one-sided taunt about an alleged attacker while the new joke candidate also captures the remark without requiring established rivalry.
Keeps the opponent's identity provisional when the same exchange disputes who was attacking.
Leaves internal canvas order unresolved because calls and progress reports do not show work allocation and ordinary posting moderation governs a different activity.
Leaves placement automation unobserved because the visible automatic tool governs posts rather than pixels.
Leaves bare acceptance unobserved because the progress reply also asks for reinforcements and cannot establish demand-free uptake.
Leaves restraint toward neighbours' art unobserved because the apology addresses bothering the audience after closure rather than canvas damage.
Leaves relocation after loss unobserved because the visitor describes seeking space rather than rebuilding an erased work.
Leaves help between identified rooms unobserved because the flag appeal identifies neither a distinct donor room nor its response.
Leaves coalition formation unobserved because naming outside communities does not establish joint work or a defence alliance with the host.
Leaves a pre-canvas tie naming an attack rival unobserved because national history appears in a design objection rather than an attack call.
Leaves an inherited quarrel unobserved because an institutional joke and nationalist concerns do not establish a prior inter-room dispute carried into placing.
Leaves host April Fools parody unobserved because the flag appeal and ordinary moderation supply no evidence of a prank framing.
Leaves completion celebration unobserved because the expansion report remains a call for defence under pressure.
Leaves decisions to carry the effort onward unobserved because ending one request does not reveal what participants kept elsewhere.
Leaves initiated hostile action by the host unobserved because defence appeals and a guest request seeking consent do not demonstrate an offensive.
Leaves the revised authority entry unobserved because permission seeking receives activity and symbolism objections without a mandate dispute or stated limit on committing placers.
Leaves the revised retained-account entry unobserved because the post-close exchange contests a proposed symbol without disputing cleanup, preserved damage, or a false account of completed work.
Leaves chat planning unobserved because the coordinate link locates canvas work without identifying a planning venue.
Leaves basic canvas explanation unobserved because locating the flag and correcting an alleged attacker do not explain canvas rules, timers, or controls.
Leaves recruitment through the mark unobserved because the guest does not say seeing the artwork caused discovery of the host subreddit.
Leaves formation of a canvas room unobserved because invoking a national faction does not show founding, recruiting, or organising a new group.
Leaves policing offensive wording or hate symbols unobserved because the plane objection establishes historical suitability concerns without identifying a hate symbol or a slur.
Leaves attention from creators, teams, companies, streamers, or press unobserved because the appeals address pixel help and guest space rather than outside recognition.
Leaves arguments about covering fairness unobserved because the objection concerns national symbolism rather than whether replacing the existing characters would be fair.
Leaves withdrawal under personal strain or repaired member quarrels unobserved because the apology responds to closure rather than reported distress or reconciliation.
Leaves secrecy and infiltration unobserved because public attack accusations and corrections do not demonstrate covert access or hidden planning.
Leaves sabotage prompted by canvas-post objections unobserved because the automatic posting instructions neither report nor solicit damage to the host's mark.
Leaves personal schedules, device constraints, and placement costs unobserved because the progress report discusses expansion and pressure without describing those limits.
Leaves technical fault reports and fixes unobserved because marking the event's closure does not report a canvas glitch, timer fault, or workaround.
Leaves dual belonging across a border or contest unobserved because the visitor names outside affiliations without claiming membership of both sides.
Leaves call-caused building untested because the progress reply never attributes the reported expansion to the preceding call.
Leaves start-caused recruitment untested because the plane proposal leads to asking permission while the flag appeal describes already-existing defence.
Explains built lettering becoming work to keep when returning blue prompts another reinforcement request within the same report.
Leaves maintenance-caused negotiation untested because the later guest proposal does not recall or answer the earlier defence.
Leaves agreement-caused restraint untested because the guest request ends without a visible agreement or evidence of resulting restraint.
Leaves maintenance-to-machine escalation unobserved because renewed pressure prompts a reinforcement call without mentioning placement automation.
Leaves building-to-celebration unobserved because the expansion report describes returning blue and requests further defence rather than announcing completion.
Leaves celebration-caused recording untested because closure is marked without a linked completion ritual or preservation request.
Leaves recording-to-continuation unobserved because marking closure ends the request without an expressed plan to carry it onward.
Leaves shortage-caused relocation untested because scarce space explains seeking consent rather than moving a lost work.
Leaves design-to-settling-template unobserved because the plane discussion addresses permission and symbolism without producing an agreed layout.
Leaves a call followed by bare acceptance unobserved because the visible progress response requests additional hands.
Leaves maintenance-to-help transfer unobserved because the defence appeals do not report an identifiable other room sending assistance.
Leaves negotiation-to-help trading unobserved because the guest proposal ends without a deal or reported exchange of assistance.
Leaves recruitment-to-host-initiated attack unobserved because the calls request construction and defence rather than an offensive against a rival work.
Leaves attack-caused restraint untested because the permission request is not an observed attack and the apology concerns bothering the host.
Leaves attack-caused negotiation untested because the visitor asks for consent without reporting a preceding attack.
Leaves attack-caused verbal contest untested because the joke follows an attribution correction without establishing the alleged attack's source.
Leaves maintenance-to-coalition unobserved because repeated reinforcement requests do not establish joint defence agreements.
Leaves flood-caused host framing untested because the automatic submission response does not describe a canvas flood or a rule adopted in response.
Leaves the bounded agreement-to-compliance-dispute mechanism untested because no agreement or related disclaimer of binding authority is observed.
